sub_graphs.title: Prague: Identity Precompile Invocation
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle of a call to the identity precompiled contract

nodes.label: Identity Precompile Called
nodes.description: EVM has routed execution to the identity precompile address

nodes.label: Gas Charged
nodes.description: Gas for identity operation has been successfully deducted

nodes.label: Output Set
nodes.description: Input data has been copied to output buffer

nodes.label: Identity Complete
nodes.description: Identity precompile execution finished successfully

nodes.label: Receive Message Data
nodes.description: Access input data from evm.message.data

nodes.label: Calculate Word Count
nodes.description: Compute ceil32(len(data))/32 for gas calculation

nodes.label: Charge Identity Gas
nodes.description: Charge GAS_IDENTITY + GAS_IDENTITY_WORD * word_count

nodes.label: Copy to Output
nodes.description: Assign evm.message.data directly to evm.output

edges.label: Contract calls identity precompile at address 0x04

external_entities.name: Calling Contract
external_entities.description: Smart contract or EOA invoking the identity precompile

sub_graphs.title: Prague: Identity Precompile Gas Costs
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas cost calculation for the identity precompile

nodes.label: Gas Available
nodes.description: Gas available before identity precompile execution

nodes.label: Sufficient Gas
nodes.description: Enough gas available for the operation

nodes.label: Insufficient Gas
nodes.description: Not enough gas, operation will fail

nodes.label: Get Input Length
nodes.description: Determine length of input data in bytes

nodes.label: Round to 32-Byte Boundary
nodes.description: Apply ceil32() to round up to nearest 32-byte word

nodes.label: Compute Word Count
nodes.description: Divide rounded length by 32 to get word count

nodes.label: Compute Total Gas
nodes.description: Calculate GAS_IDENTITY + (GAS_IDENTITY_WORD * word_count)

nodes.label: Deduct Gas
nodes.description: Subtract computed gas from available gas

sub_graphs.title: Prague: Identity Precompile Security Model
sub_graphs.description: Models the trust boundary and security characteristics of the identity precompile

nodes.label: External Data Received
nodes.description: Arbitrary data from external caller has been received

nodes.label: Data Unvalidated
nodes.description: Identity precompile performs no validation on input data

nodes.label: Data Passed Through
nodes.description: Input data is returned unchanged as output

nodes.label: Accept Any Input
nodes.description: No restrictions on input data content or format

nodes.label: Copy Without Modification
nodes.description: Data is copied byte-for-byte without any transformation

external_entities.name: Untrusted Caller
external_entities.description: Any contract or EOA can call the identity precompile with arbitrary data

ambiguities.text: The specification does not explicitly state what happens when input data length is zero.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume zero-length input is valid and results in zero-length output with only GAS_IDENTITY base cost charged.

ambiguities.text: The specific values of GAS_IDENTITY and GAS_IDENTITY_WORD constants are not defined in this file.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume these are standard constants defined elsewhere (historically GAS_IDENTITY=15, GAS_IDENTITY_WORD=3).

implicit_assumptions.description: The identity precompile is intentionally designed to have no security restrictions - it simply copies data.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: N/A - the simplicity is a feature, not a security concern for this precompile.

implicit_assumptions.description: Memory allocation for copying data is bounded by gas costs and cannot cause resource exhaustion.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Large inputs could potentially cause memory exhaustion if gas costs do not adequately bound the operation.

implicit_assumptions.description: The caller correctly handles the output data and does not assume any validation has been performed.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Contracts expecting the identity precompile to validate data would be vulnerable to malformed input.
